description: Implementasi sisi Dokter untuk Online Consultation System: daftar konsultasi terjadwal, room chat konsultasi, manajemen link meeting (Zoom/Google Meet/Microsoft Teams/Custom), ringkasan pasien, dan quick actions.
notes: Backend: migrasi doctor_id di consultations + tabel consultation_messages & consultation_meetings; model ConsultationMessage & ConsultationMeeting; controller DoctorConsultationController (index+dashboard+show+updateStatus+assign+patientSummary), ConsultationMessageController, ConsultationMeetingController; rute baru di routes/api.php; seeder OnlineConsultationSeeder. Frontend: struktur features/doctor/consultation/{dashboard,instant,scheduled,shared} dengan pages/components/services/hooks/types/utils/validation/constants; ChatWindow reusable (chat engine), MeetingLinkPanel, PatientSummaryPanel, StatusBadge, QuickActions, ConsultationSummaryCards; halaman ScheduledConsultationListPage (tombol Masuk Chat) dan ConsultationChatPage di route /dashboard/doctor/consultation/:id. Hanya konsultasi terjadwal yang tampil di tampilan dokter.
reason: Sesuai prompt.md: implementasi doctor-side saja, backend-first, tanpa data mock, semua data dari REST API Laravel via seeder.
author: Antigravity AI | Developer
